mentions.h: Ted Pallant: President of Belgrave Harriers 1996-1997

photos.c: Left: Nearly two miles gone in the '5¾'. It's September 1966 and among the 39 competitors in the race, this bunch are out to settle personal scores - or perhaps just enjoy the sunshine. The runners are: Financial wizards Keith Miller (106) and Jim Heathfield (93), Ted Pallant (94), talented youth and junior Tony Brooks (37) - lost to the sport before making impact as a senior, Dave McMillan (12) - now fighting back from terrible injuries sustained while out training and hit by a car, P.Blair-Fish (46).

share.d: P. Blair-Fish in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1997: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 photograph.
